scoring_justification: Checker recomputes barrier from ground/transition energies, cross-checks consistency and plausible energy ranges, then compares barrier_eV to the paper gold within tolerance. Full recompute from raw MM trajectory is infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for barrier_eV and allowed energy windows
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table III and text: barrier 0.30 eV, ground state energy -3169.06 kJ/mol, transition state energy -3142.70 kJ/mol
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper's Table III and main text; allowed windows set to ±10% of paper values to catch gross errors.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published results; they are the reference target for reproduction.

outputs.description: The migration barrier and the component energies after MM optimization.

output_contract.notes: The verifier will recompute barrier_eV from the reported energies and compare the result to the expected value with a tolerance. The MM engine must support the UFF force field and charge equilibration.

steps.description: Verify migration barrier JSON file: schema, internal consistency, energy range plausibility, and barrier_eV match within tolerance.
